name: @fluidgrids/mcp-server

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_login
tools.description: Start the device code login flow. Returns a verification URL and user code immediately (non-blocking). The user must open the URL in a browser and enter the code, then call vibecontrols_auth_complete to finish.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_complete
tools.description: Check if the user has completed the device code authorization in their browser. Call this after the user has opened the verification URL and entered the code from vibecontrols_auth_login. Returns "pending" if not yet authorized, "authenticated" on success.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_select_workspace
tools.description: Select a workspace after login (when multiple workspaces are available). Issues a workspace-scoped token.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_workspaces
tools.description: List all workspaces available to the authenticated user.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_status
tools.description: Show current authentication status including method, token expiration, workspace info, and pending login state.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_logout
tools.description: Log out and clear all stored authentication tokens.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_sign_up
tools.description: Register a new account via email/username/password and immediately sign in. Persists access + refresh tokens. Returns { user, accessToken, refreshToken, expiresIn }.

email.description: Email address for the new account

password.description: Password (caller is responsible for strength policy)

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_sign_in
tools.description: Sign in with username + password (server-side credential flow, distinct from the device-code `auth_login`). Persists access + refresh tokens. Returns { user, accessToken, refreshToken, expiresIn }.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_refresh_token
tools.description: Exchange the stored refreshToken for a fresh access + refresh pair. The gql client auto-refreshes when tokens are near expiry; use this tool only when you need to force a refresh now. Persists new tokens. Returns the new { accessToken, expiresIn }.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_authenticate_app
tools.description: Machine-to-machine auth via the `authenticateApp` GraphQL mutation. Pass an OAuth app client_id + client_secret (and optional scopes) to receive an access token; persists token for subsequent calls. Returns { accessToken, tokenType, expiresIn, scopes }.

clientSecret.description: OAuth app clientSecret (shown only once on app creation)

scopes.description: Optional list of scope strings to request

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_login_with_api_key
tools.description: Authenticate with a pre-issued API key (headless service mode). The key is stored locally and sent as `X-API-Key` on every gateway request; no network call is made by this tool. Use auth_status to verify. Returns { status: "authenticated", method: "api_key" }.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_login_with_client_credentials
tools.description: OAuth2 client_credentials grant (REST against oidcIssuer/token). Equivalent to auth_authenticate_app but uses the OIDC token endpoint instead of the GraphQL mutation; prefer auth_authenticate_app inside the platform. Persists the issued token. Returns { accessToken, expiresIn, scopes }.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_profile_get
tools.description: Show the current authenticated user (id, email, name, role, status).

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_profile_update
tools.description: Update the current user profile (any subset of fields).

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_sessions_list
tools.description: List active sessions for the current user (browser/device sessions).

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_sessions_revoke
tools.description: Revoke (sign out) a single session by id.

confirm.description: Must be true to execute this destructive tool. The call is rejected (no changes made) if omitted or false.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_mfa_list
tools.description: List MFA methods enrolled for the current user.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_mfa_enroll
tools.description: Begin MFA enrollment. Returns the qrCode, secret, and one-time backup codes the user must save BEFORE calling auth_mfa_verify.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_mfa_verify
tools.description: Verify MFA enrollment by submitting the code from the authenticator.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_mfa_disable
tools.description: Disable MFA for the current user.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_api_keys_list
tools.description: List API keys for the current user; pass appId to scope to a specific app.

appId.description: Restrict to keys owned by an app id

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_api_keys_create
tools.description: Generate a new API key for an app. Returns apiKey + apiSecret — the secret is only shown once.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_api_keys_revoke
tools.description: Revoke an API key by its keyId.

confirm.description: Must be true to execute this destructive tool. The call is rejected (no changes made) if omitted or false.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_api_keys_rotate
tools.description: Rotate an API key — invalidates the previous secret and returns a new one (shown only once).

confirm.description: Must be true to execute this destructive tool. The call is rejected (no changes made) if omitted or false.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_audit_log_query
tools.description: Recent auth audit events for the current user.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_delegations_list
tools.description: Delegations granted by/to the current user.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_delegations_grant
tools.description: Grant a delegation to an app (consent on behalf of the calling user).

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_delegations_revoke
tools.description: Revoke a delegation by its id.

confirm.description: Must be true to execute this destructive tool. The call is rejected (no changes made) if omitted or false.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_apps_list
tools.description: List OAuth/system apps owned by the current user.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_apps_get
tools.description: Get a single app by its id.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_apps_create
tools.description: Create an OAuth or system app. Returns the app + clientSecret (shown only once).

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_apps_update
tools.description: Update an app (name, description, redirect URIs, scopes, status).

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_apps_deactivate
tools.description: Deactivate an app by its id (revoke is not currently a separate mutation).

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_apps_authorize_url
tools.description: Build the OAuth authorization URL for an app (browser-only flow). Returns the URL to open in a browser; this tool does not perform any server call.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_sso_get
tools.description: Get SSO (SAML/OIDC) configuration for a tenant.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_sso_configure
tools.description: Save (upsert) SSO configuration for a tenant.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_sso_test
tools.description: Build the SSO test login URL for a tenant. Returns the URL to open in a browser; this tool does not perform any server call.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_sso_delete
tools.description: Delete SSO configuration for a tenant.

confirm.description: Must be true to execute this destructive tool. The call is rejected (no changes made) if omitted or false.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_users_list
tools.description: List users with optional filters. Requires admin permission.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_users_get
tools.description: Get a user by id. Requires admin permission.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_users_update
tools.description: Update a user (admin). Pass any subset of mutable fields.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_security_summary
tools.description: One-shot account security overview: profile, MFA methods, active sessions, recent audit log, API keys, delegations.

recentLimit.description: How many recent audit events / sessions to include (default 10)

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_register_get_url
tools.description: Build the registration URL (browser-only flow). Returns the URL to open in a browser; this tool does not perform any server call.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_reset_password_get_url
tools.description: Build the password reset URL (browser-only flow). Returns the URL to open in a browser; this tool does not perform any server call.

tools.name: fluidgrids_auth_magic_link_get_url
tools.description: Build the magic-link login URL (browser-only flow). Returns the URL to open in a browser; this tool does not perform any server call.

email.description: Email to send the magic link to

tools.name: fluidgrids_workflows_list
tools.description: List FluidGrids workflow definitions with optional filters and pagination. Use latestOnly to collapse a workflowKey to its newest version.

latestOnly.description: Return only the latest version per workflowKey

tools.name: fluidgrids_workflows_get
tools.description: Get a single workflow definition by id, or by workflowKey (optionally pinned to a version). Without a version the executable version is resolved.

tools.name: fluidgrids_workflows_versions
tools.description: List every stored version of one workflowKey.

tools.name: fluidgrids_workflows_create
tools.description: Create a workflow definition. definitionJson is the node/edge graph; workflowKey plus version identify it.

tools.name: fluidgrids_workflows_update
tools.description: Update a workflow definition by id. Saving a change to a published workflow forks a new version rather than mutating the active one.

tools.name: fluidgrids_workflows_delete
tools.description: Delete a workflow by key. Without a version every version of that key is deleted.

confirm.description: Must be true to execute this destructive tool. The call is rejected (no changes made) if omitted or false.

tools.name: fluidgrids_workflows_trigger
tools.description: Start a workflow run. triggerNodeId names the trigger node to start from; stopAtNodeId runs only up to a node (step debugging).

triggerNodeId.description: ID of the trigger node to start from

triggerData.description: Payload passed to the trigger node

stopAtNodeId.description: Stop after this node and mark the run COMPLETED

tools.name: fluidgrids_workflows_publish
tools.description: Publish a workflow definition, making that version the executable one.

tools.name: fluidgrids_workflows_activate
tools.description: Activate a workflow definition. Exactly one version per workflowKey may be ACTIVE.

tools.name: fluidgrids_workflows_deactivate
tools.description: Deactivate a workflow definition so no version of the key is executable.

tools.name: fluidgrids_workflows_duplicate
tools.description: Copy an existing workflow version to a new workflowKey.

tools.name: fluidgrids_workflows_archive
tools.description: Archive a workflow definition. Reversible: archived workflows still list.

confirm.description: Must be true to execute this destructive tool. The call is rejected (no changes made) if omitted or false.

tools.name: fluidgrids_runs_list
tools.description: List workflow runs, optionally filtered by workflowKey and status.

tools.name: fluidgrids_runs_get
tools.description: Get one workflow run, including per-node state. Poll this to follow a run to a terminal status.

tools.name: fluidgrids_runs_logs
tools.description: Read a run log, newest page first. Keyset paginated: pass the previous page cursor as `after`.

after.description: Keyset cursor from a previous page

tools.name: fluidgrids_runs_cancel
tools.description: Cancel an in-flight run. Terminal runs cannot be cancelled.

confirm.description: Must be true to execute this destructive tool. The call is rejected (no changes made) if omitted or false.

tools.name: fluidgrids_runs_pause
tools.description: Pause a running workflow run.

tools.name: fluidgrids_runs_resume
tools.description: Resume a paused or waiting run. `payload` supplies the data a Wait node is blocked on.

tools.name: fluidgrids_runs_retry_node
tools.description: Re-execute one failed node within a run, continuing from there.

tools.name: fluidgrids_runs_by_workflow_id
tools.description: Read the latest visible run of a workflow ID. firstRunId pins its continue-as-new chain. Requires durable parity.

tools.name: fluidgrids_runs_describe
tools.description: Read execution kind, durable state and determinism status. A workflow-ID target also returns chain metadata.

run.description: A run ID or a workflowKey/workflowId target, optionally pinned by firstRunId

tools.name: fluidgrids_runs_pending
tools.description: Read pending activities, children, timers, buffered signals and the open workflow task. Requires durable parity.

run.description: A run ID or a workflowKey/workflowId target, optionally pinned by firstRunId

tools.name: fluidgrids_runs_count
tools.description: Count visible runs, optionally grouped by up to two columns. No pagination applies. Requires durable parity.

tools.name: fluidgrids_runs_history
tools.description: Read one bounded history page. Pass nextAfter as after; offloaded payload URLs are returned, not fetched.

run.description: A run ID or a workflowKey/workflowId target, optionally pinned by firstRunId

tools.name: fluidgrids_runs_signal
tools.description: Send a signal, potentially resuming a workflow and external actions. Use an idempotencyKey for safe retries. Gateway execute permission and feature gates apply.

run.description: A run ID or a workflowKey/workflowId target, optionally pinned by firstRunId

confirm.description: Must be true to execute this destructive tool. The call is rejected (no changes made) if omitted or false.

tools.name: fluidgrids_runs_stack_trace
tools.description: Read the current replayed stack trace. Enhanced traces and optional metadata describe current execution; metadata and workflow-ID targets require durable parity.

run.description: A run ID or a workflowKey/workflowId target, optionally pinned by firstRunId

tools.name: fluidgrids_runs_determinism
tools.description: Read whether workflow tasks keep failing and why, without changing run state.

tools.name: fluidgrids_runs_terminate
tools.description: Immediately stop a run without cancellation handlers. This is destructive and requires gateway workflow-run delete permission.

run.description: A run ID or a workflowKey/workflowId target, optionally pinned by firstRunId

confirm.description: Must be true to execute this destructive tool. The call is rejected (no changes made) if omitted or false.

tools.name: fluidgrids_workflows_start
tools.description: Start a durable workflow, which may execute external actions. Confirm intent before calling. TERMINATE_EXISTING terminates the open run and uses the separate delete-permission gateway operation. Parity options require durable parity.

confirm.description: Must be true to execute this destructive tool. The call is rejected (no changes made) if omitted or false.

tools.name: fluidgrids_workflows_export
tools.description: Read a portable workflow document or generated code with a fidelity report. Returned file URLs are not downloaded.

tools.name: fluidgrids_workflows_interface
tools.description: Read the typed interface of a workflow version; null when none exists.

tools.name: fluidgrids_workflows_validate
tools.description: Validate definition JSON without saving or executing it. strict adds code-authored IR rules.

tools.name: fluidgrids_workflows_create_version
tools.description: Add a workflow version without running it. Preserve baseVersion/expectedRevision/editSessionId for optimistic concurrency.

tools.name: fluidgrids_workflows_import
tools.description: Create a DRAFT from exactly one of definitionJson or inline source files. The service validates/builds source; no workflow is started. Never put literal credentials in imported source.

tools.name: fluidgrids_workflows_import_template
tools.description: Import a store template as a DRAFT workflow. This does not purchase a template, activate it or run it.

tools.name: fluidgrids_nodes_list
tools.description: List the node types available to build workflows with, from the node endpoint config registry.

tools.name: fluidgrids_nodes_get
tools.description: Get one node type at a specific version, including its input fields and operations.

tools.name: fluidgrids_credentials_list
tools.description: List stored connections (credentials) available to workflows.

tools.name: fluidgrids_credentials_get
tools.description: Get one connection by ID. Secret material is never returned.

tools.name: fluidgrids_credentials_list_types
tools.description: List the providers a connection can be created against.

tools.name: fluidgrids_credentials_create
tools.description: Create a connection against a provider. Secrets go to the vault; pass a reference, never a raw secret in config.

vaultId.description: Vault to store secret material in

tools.name: fluidgrids_credentials_update
tools.description: Update a connection’s name, description or non-secret config.

tools.name: fluidgrids_credentials_delete
tools.description: Delete a connection. Set deleteVaultSecret to also destroy the stored secret — that is irreversible.

confirm.description: Must be true to execute this destructive tool. The call is rejected (no changes made) if omitted or false.

tools.name: fluidgrids_credentials_test
tools.description: Verify a connection can authenticate against its provider.

tools.name: fluidgrids_credentials_auth_api_key
tools.description: Attach an API key to a connection via the API-key auth flow.

tools.name: fluidgrids_credentials_auth_basic
tools.description: Attach basic-auth credentials to a connection.

tools.name: fluidgrids_webhooks_list
tools.description: List event registrations (webhooks) that can trigger workflows.

tools.name: fluidgrids_webhooks_get
tools.description: Get one event registration by ID.

tools.name: fluidgrids_webhooks_create
tools.description: Register an event source that triggers a workflow. triggerNodeId names the trigger node the event enters at. eventSource and eventType are required by the server schema (CreateEventRegistrationInput!); marking them optional in the tool wrapper produced a "Field eventSource of required type String! was not provided" error on every call (BOFF-8204).

tools.name: fluidgrids_webhooks_update
tools.description: Update an event registration.

tools.name: fluidgrids_webhooks_toggle
tools.description: Enable or disable an event registration without deleting it.

isActive.description: True to enable, false to disable

tools.name: fluidgrids_webhooks_delete
tools.description: Delete an event registration permanently.

confirm.description: Must be true to execute this destructive tool. The call is rejected (no changes made) if omitted or false.

tools.name: fluidgrids_scheduled_jobs_list
tools.description: List schedules that trigger workflows on a cron or interval.

tools.name: fluidgrids_scheduled_jobs_get
tools.description: Get one scheduled job by ID.

tools.name: fluidgrids_scheduled_jobs_create
tools.description: Schedule a workflow. `schedule` is the cron or interval expression the scheduler service evaluates.

tools.name: fluidgrids_scheduled_jobs_update
tools.description: Update a scheduled job’s name, schedule, config or enabled state.

tools.name: fluidgrids_scheduled_jobs_delete
tools.description: Delete a scheduled job permanently.

confirm.description: Must be true to execute this destructive tool. The call is rejected (no changes made) if omitted or false.

tools.name: fluidgrids_dashboard_summary
tools.description: Workflow, run and failure counters for the current workspace.

tools.name: fluidgrids_usage_metrics
tools.description: Usage metrics over a date range — run minutes and execution counts.

tools.name: fluidgrids_search
tools.description: Search across FluidGrids entities. Narrow with entityTypes when you know it.

tools.name: fluidgrids_search_by_entity_type
tools.description: Search within a single entity type.

tools.name: fluidgrids_system_config
tools.description: Read the workflow engine’s effective system configuration.

tools.name: fluidgrids_workspace_current
tools.description: Inspect the workspace currently bound to this MCP session (workspace ID, organization ID, and whether a workspace token is held).

tools.name: fluidgrids_workspace_list
tools.description: List workspaces visible to the current actor on the workspace gateway, with optional filters and pagination. Returns { items, total, hasMore }.

status.description: Filter by workspace status (will be uppercased; e.g. ACTIVE|ARCHIVED)

tools.name: fluidgrids_workspace_get
tools.description: Get a workspace by its ID (global layer).

tools.name: fluidgrids_workspace_create
tools.description: Create a workspace (global layer). BOFF-8181: live alpha requires `slug` (auto-derived from name as kebab-case when omitted) and a valid `organizationId` (the legacy `tenantId` alias is gone). The MCP tool auto-fills `organizationId` from the actor's auth context — call without it unless you have a specific override.

slug.description: URL slug (auto-derived from name as kebab-case when omitted)

organizationId.description: Owning organization id (defaults to the actor's organization from the access token)

tools.name: fluidgrids_workspace_update
tools.description: Update a workspace (global layer). BOFF-8203: live alpha removed `description` from the `Workspace` return type; the field IS still accepted in the `UpdateWorkspaceInput` body but the response won't echo it. At least one field must be provided.

description.description: Updated description (live alpha won't echo this on the response)

tools.name: fluidgrids_workspace_delete
tools.description: Delete a workspace by its ID (global layer).

confirm.description: Must be true to execute this destructive tool. The call is rejected (no changes made) if omitted or false.

tools.name: fluidgrids_workspace_members_list
tools.description: List members of a workspace. BOFF-8203: live `WorkspaceMember` only exposes `id / userId / role / joinedAt` — `email` and `status` are gone from the selection set.

tools.name: fluidgrids_workspace_members_add
tools.description: Add a member to the active workspace. Live `addWorkspaceMember(input: { userId })` (workspaces endpoint). Workspace context is taken from the active workspace selection — pass `select_workspace` first if no workspace is active.

userId.description: User ID to add to the active workspace

tools.name: fluidgrids_workspace_members_remove
tools.description: Remove a workspace member. Live alpha: `removeWorkspaceMember(id: ID!)` (workspaces endpoint, membership id). Get the id from `workspace_members_list` first.

confirm.description: Must be true to execute this destructive tool. The call is rejected (no changes made) if omitted or false.

tools.name: fluidgrids_workspace_members_role
tools.description: Update a workspace member's role. Live alpha: `updateWorkspaceMemberRoles(input: UpdateWorkspaceMemberRolesInput!)` where the input is `{ userId, roleIds }`. Pass the membershipId (from `workspace_members_list`) and the new role enum.

tools.name: fluidgrids_workspace_projects_list
tools.description: List projects, optionally filtered by workspace. Returns { items, total, hasMore }.

tools.name: fluidgrids_workspace_projects_get
tools.description: Get a project by its ID.

tools.name: fluidgrids_workspace_projects_create
tools.description: Create a project in the current workspace (workspace comes from the session context).

tools.name: fluidgrids_workspace_invites_accept
tools.description: Accept a workspace invitation by invitation ID. Returns { id, status, workspaceId } of the accepted invite.

tools.name: fluidgrids_workspace_activity
tools.description: Workspace activity log (audit events) for a given workspace.

tools.name: fluidgrids_rbac_roles_create
tools.description: Create a new RBAC role at the workspace or global layer.

tools.name: fluidgrids_rbac_check
tools.description: Check whether an actor has permission for an action on a resource.

tools.name: fluidgrids_tags_list
tools.description: List tags in the current workspace, optionally filtered by text, vocabulary or parent. Returns { items, total, hasMore, nextCursor }.

tools.description: Get one tag with its hierarchy position and usage counts.

tools.description: List the tag vocabularies (taxonomies) available in the current workspace. Every tag belongs to a vocabulary, so call this before tags_create.

applicableEntityType.description: Only vocabularies that apply to this entity type (e.g. file)

tools.name: fluidgrids_tags_analytics
tools.description: Daily assignment / removal / unique-user counts for a tag over a time window.

color.description: Color value stored with the tag

parentId.description: Parent tag ID for hierarchical taxonomies

tools.description: Update a tag. Provide at least one of label, description, color, icon, parentId or displayOrder.

tools.description: List the tag assignments on one workspace entity.

entityType.description: Entity type, e.g. file, folder, project

tools.name: fluidgrids_tags_assignment_remove
tools.description: Remove one tag assignment (by assignment ID from tags_entity_list).

tools.name: fluidgrids_files_list

tools.name: fluidgrids_files_get
